scope: Static recheck only; no script, Git mutation, product execution, build, upload or remote write by reviewer.

resolved_findings.evidence: Both output directory and archive must be absent; directory uses exist_ok=False and ZIP uses exclusive x creation.

ASCII label allowlist; canonical relative change paths; explicit P29/documentary/production/adapter allowlist; stage zero; blob type and mode 100644; canonical ordinary working files; captured bytes equal working bytes.

Change set comes from parent to captured immutable expected_tree. Each mode/blob comes from that tree, matches the index, and content is read by immutable blob ID. HEAD and write-tree are rechecked before the manifest is frozen. Deletions and nonordinary files fail closed.

additional_checks: Archive reopens; CRC, JSON intent equality, every payload size/SHA256 and Git blob SHA1 are checked.
Exact parent, base tree, expected tree, mode/blob, bytes and content encoding are retained.
No network or GitHub operation exists in this script. Local git write-tree is Director-owned.
Current repository/packages paths resolve canonically and are ordinary directories; publication output root does not yet exist.
limits: Acceptance authorizes no remote publication and does not validate any not-yet-created staged payload or ZIP.
Director must preserve prior attempts, stage only reviewed scope, and avoid concurrent mutation while capturing.
Constructed recovery ZIP, exact accepted fixture freeze, save/readback and any later conditional publication remain separate acceptance gates.
